intro: This page lists the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Madhya Pradesh by the average packages in our records. We currently link {{count}} programme options at {{colleges}} public colleges.

IIM Indore is the main national institute here, with IIFM Bhopal, MANIT, ABV-IIITM Gwalior and several state campuses. Packages are historical records, and some years in our file go back to {{pkgYearMin}}.
listLead: IIM Indore appears first. The opening card may be the five-year Integrated Programme in Management rather than the two-year PGP, so read the programme name before you compare packages.
snapshot: For colleges with a recorded average package, the median is {{pkgMedian}}, in a range from {{pkgMin}} to {{pkgMax}}. The recorded years run from {{pkgYearMin}} to {{pkgYearMax}}.
Some highest-package figures in our file look unusually high, so confirm them in the official reports when you compare top MBA / PGDM colleges in Madhya Pradesh 2026.
firstCollegesLead: IIM Indore has a 2024 recorded average of ₹26 LPA on an IPM row, with a highest of ₹100 LPA. Confirm the flagship PGP figures in the official placement report, because IPM and PGP are different programmes.
IIFM Bhopal and MANIT each have a 2023 recorded average of ₹11 LPA. In the official NIRF 2025 Management ranking, IIM Indore is 8 and ABV-IIITM Gwalior is 93.

compare.heading: How to compare the best government MBA / PGDM colleges in Madhya Pradesh
paragraphs: A forestry, tourism or footwear MBA is not the same product as IIM Indore's PGP. Compare the award, the official fee and the year of the data.
